text:
Shalom everyone! I wrote a post two days ago, but I don't see it in the group feed. 🤷‍♀️

Yesterday, I went to Misrad HaPnim (Afula) to get an inter-visa. I was hoping they would have a confirmation for my A5 visa (our interview was on August 16th,  B1 expired on the 10th), but unfortunately, no. They are keeping me on a B1 visa until December, while my son currently does not have a valid visa at all.

It is so frustrating that I cannot take my son with me to Romania, especially since this is a family emergency.

Another thing I don't understand is why they are keeping me on a B1 visa for so long instead of upgrading me to an A5 (we are married). The private health insurance cost is so high for both me and my son. We arrived in Israel on December 31st, so it will be almost a year and a half before I can finally benefit from Bituach Leumi.
Thank you all!

Lior Beres
